verdict.rationale: PostHog offers official SDKs across many languages plus an HTTP API for capturing events, a documented OpenAPI spec, and CLI/MCP tooling that lets AI-native devs build against these SDKs directly (posthog-docs-11, posthog-probe-3, posthog-docs-20, posthog-probe-5). Community evidence corroborates real integration (posthog-comm-3) though also shows friction with LLM features (posthog-comm-8), which is unrelated to SDK quality itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of individual language SDK quality/completeness, and no explicit SDK changelog/versioning evidence.
